none: PAS NLM-686B4B: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Constantine (306-361), Gloria exercitus issue of 335-341, Reece period 17, probably Trier mint. Obverse description: Bust diademed cuirassed right; upright hair in 'Celtic' style and large eye. Obverse inscription: CON[----] AVG. Reverse description: Two soldiers with one standard between them; possibly O on vexillum, eagle atop standard. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. Diameter: 16.9mm, Weight: 0.94gms, die axis: 6
